REV-1 [USR-006] Every dialog that moved to the side pane (confirmations, update, help, theme finder) is unreadable in the app's default dark theme: the package pane stays light while the dialog text keeps the app's light colours. USR-006 requires readable/contrasting theme combinations; the pane needs the app theme (ZestLayoutThemeProvider, or a pane background taken from the app theme).

REV-2 [R6] The user-facing shortcut documentation still tells the user that F5 refreshes, contradicting R6 ('No menu, palette entry or help text still tells the user that F5 refreshes') and its pitfall that any leftover F5-refresh hint must be brought in line. All user-visible F5-refresh wording must now describe Start all / Stop all.
